visual_environment.illumination: Storm-dark sacred weather split by abrupt gold-white lightning or numinous glare from beyond the human frame.
visual_environment.palette: Thunder grey, near-black, cold blue, parchment, and fierce gold-white.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Theocratic, primal, terrifying, pre-rational, and charged before meaning stabilizes.
visual_environment.motion: Descent, strike, tremor, sudden revelation, or tiny human movement under enormous forces.
visual_environment.density: Large atmospheric mass with small human figures or signs.
visual_environment.material_effects: Etched/clouded ink masses deepen; white paper or pale lithographic reserve tears through like lightning; gold acts as dangerous revelation rather than decoration.

visual_environment.illumination: Low declining heroic sun or bronze twilight, long shadows, and sculptural side-light.
visual_environment.palette: Burnished bronze, twilight purple, cold stone, dark wine, and fading gold.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Monumental, aristocratic, theatrical, proud, and already touched by decline.
visual_environment.motion: Pose, procession, ascent, duel, or grand gesture held long enough to become statue.
visual_environment.density: Moderate with one or a few enlarged forms and long shadow-fields.
visual_environment.material_effects: Lithographic/etched forms acquire bronze-like plate tone, long crosshatched shadows, and statuary stillness without turning into fantasy metal rendering.

visual_environment.illumination: Flat democratic daylight across streets, rooms, shops, schools, pubs, and ordinary civic surfaces.
visual_environment.palette: Newsprint grey, brown Liffey, brick, muted green, cream, black type, and ordinary clothing color.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Prosaic, civic, busy, human-scale, unheroic, and clearly observable.
visual_environment.motion: Walking, buying, teaching, eating, talking, working, waiting, crossing streets.
visual_environment.density: Moderate distributed activity with many ordinary details and no exalted focal hierarchy.
visual_environment.material_effects: Newsprint tooth, letterpress, map/advertisement fragments, documentary line, and ordinary ink spread become more visible; ornament recedes.

visual_environment.illumination: Night-blue dissolution shading toward faint dawn; reflected or source-less light emerges through river-fog and dream.
visual_environment.palette: Deep blue-black, ink violet, river silver, washed green, faint rose/gold of return.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Dreaming, dissolving, recursive, riverine, linguistic, and poised between ending and beginning.
visual_environment.motion: Flow, melt, loop, echo, backward current, recombination, and soft return.
visual_environment.density: Layered but porous; forms overlap, dissolve, and leave openings for the next cycle.
visual_environment.material_effects: Ink bleeds, words fragment/recombine, plate edges soften, graphite erases into wash, and page fiber shows through as forms return toward source.
